audit_items.proof_trace: Verification delegated to external preview library (Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1 v1.0.0-preview.6) with no cross-client consensus validation. Different Ethereum clients use different cryptographic libraries (C# vs Go vs Java vs Rust), creating risk of edge-case disagreement on malleability, point encoding, or signature format parsing that could cause consensus splits.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts edge-case P256 signature that verifies differently across client implementations (e.g., high-s malleability or point-at-infinity handling), includes it in a transaction, causing network consensus split and enabling chain reorganization or double-spend attacks.
